disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与打包产物中的敏感信息读取面（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、密钥与令牌路径），未检出任何读取或搜集凭据的代码；机械扫描中凭据读取类规则命中 0 条。
checked_items.en: All reading surfaces for sensitive information (credential files, SSH private keys, secret and token paths) in both source code and packaged artifacts were inspected; no code reading or collecting credentials was detected; mechanical scanning hit 0 rules for credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 模型可见文本（系统提示词段落、技能文件）中明确写入『GenUI 不得索取密码、API Key、访问令牌、恢复码等秘密』的禁令；浏览器端对密码输入做了不持久化、不进入表单收集的处理（多处源码注释与实现均体现该边界）。
checked_items.en: Model-visible texts (system prompt paragraphs, skill files) explicitly include the prohibition "GenUI must not ask for passwords, API keys, access tokens, recovery codes, or other secrets"; on the browser side, password input is handled without persistence and without entering form collection (this boundary is reflected in multiple source code comments and implementations).

evidence.zh: 未检出读取任何凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；客户端对密码输入显式做了不持久化、不收集处理，本场景未命中。
evidence.en: No code reading any credential file or sensitive path was detected; the client explicitly handles password input without persistence or collection, so this scenario did not trigger.

checked_items.zh: 对系统提示词注入面逐条核查：插件注册的一段系统提示词段落（机械命中规则 DSH-T02 / DG-R2-52，位于 lib/index.js:1409 与 src/plugin/index.ts:152）内容是 dsh-ui 围栏语法与使用纪律的教学文本，不含指令覆写、权限操纵、索取秘密等任何注入措辞，反而包含『秘密禁令』。
checked_items.en: System prompt injection surface checked item by item: the registered system prompt paragraph (mechanically hit rules DSH-T02 / DG-R2-52, located at lib/index.js:1409 and src/plugin/index.ts:152) is instructional text for dsh-ui fence syntax and usage discipline, containing no injection wording such as instruction override, permission manipulation, or secret solicitation, and instead includes a "secret prohibition".

checked_items.zh: 技能文件（机械命中规则 DSH-X10 / DG-R2-57，SKILL.md）全文精读：是 UI 组件语法、使用时机与数量纪律说明，无『忽略之前指令』『远程拉取指令』『系统消息伪装』等注入措辞；对指令覆写与权限绕过类短语的全文搜索命中 0。
checked_items.en: The skill file (mechanically hit rules DSH-X10 / DG-R2-57, SKILL.md) was read in full: it describes UI component syntax, usage timing, and quantity discipline, with no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions", "fetch remote instructions", or "disguise as system messages"; full-text search for instruction-override and permission-bypass phrases hit 0.

checked_items.zh: 两个注册工具（渲染 UI、校验围栏）的描述与参数说明为良性的 UI 渲染说明，无诱导安装、诱导改写配置、诱导放开权限或诱导输入凭证的措辞。
checked_items.en: The descriptions and parameter explanations of the two registered tools (render UI, validate fence) are benign UI rendering descriptions, with no wording inducing installation, config rewriting, permission elevation, or credential entry.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与系统提示词段落均为 UI 渲染教学文本，未检出系统指令、凭证诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompt paragraphs are UI rendering instructional text; no system instructions, credential solicitation, or hidden intent were detected.

evidence.zh: 未检出任何诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；技能与提示词反而强调本地优先、拒绝索取秘密。
evidence.en: No wording inducing the model to execute installs, rewrite configuration, or elevate permissions was detected; skills and prompts instead emphasize local-first behavior and refusing to solicit secrets.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型输入改写事件，不存在改写或注入用户消息的面；客户端仅把用户操作以普通消息经宿主通道回传模型。
evidence.en: No model input rewriting event is hooked; there is no surface for rewriting or injecting user messages; the client only forwards user operations to the model via the host channel as ordinary messages.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码（主机半区与浏览器半区）未使用 eval、new Function、子进程等危险执行手段；机械命中的子进程调用（规则 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55）全部位于开发脚本（打包前构建、打包校验、端到端测试）与测试代码中，不随插件安装或运行执行，逐条核查为良性开发工具。
checked_items.en: Runtime code (host half and browser half) does not use dangerous execution methods such as eval, new Function, or child processes; the mechanically hit child-process calls (rules DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55) are all located in development scripts (pre-build, package verification, end-to-end tests) and test code, and are not executed during plugin installation or runtime; each was reviewed as a benign development tool.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅做自身插件插入登记，不含可执行 YAML 标量；包声明无任何安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 均无）；无动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）调用。
checked_items.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) only registers the plugin itself for insertion and contains no executable YAML scalars; the package manifest has no install hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); no dynamic package tool (cordis_define/cordis_run) calls are present.

checked_items.zh: 压缩/打包形态命中（规则 DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60，涉及 lib/assets/three.js、lib/client.js、lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts、src/client/mermaid-safe.ts）经文件头部核验与 CI 的『打包产物与源码一致』校验，确认为第三方库（three/mermaid）、正常构建产物与字符串常量，非混淆后门；剪贴板命中（规则 DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57）为『复制』组件功能。
checked_items.en: Compression/packaging hits (rules DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60, involving lib/assets/three.js, lib/client.js, lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts, src/client/mermaid-safe.ts) were verified via file headers and the CI's "packaged artifacts match source" check, confirming they are third-party libraries (three/mermaid), normal build artifacts, and string constants, not obfuscated backdoors; the clipboard hit (rule DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57) corresponds to the "copy" component functionality.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流（规则 DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/ci.yml）为常规测试、构建与打包校验流水线，属开发基础设施，不随插件在用户侧运行。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow (rule DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/ci.yml) is a standard test, build, and package verification pipeline, belonging to development infrastructure and not executed on the user side with the plugin.

evidence.zh: 全部 YAML 配置（含挂载配置）无 !!js 可执行标量，挂载配置仅做自身插件插入登记。
evidence.en: All YAML configs (including the patch config) contain no !!js executable scalars; the patch config only registers the plugin itself for insertion.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具（cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (cordis_define / cordis_run) were detected.

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装钩子；仓库内一键安装脚本是用户主动运行的辅助脚本，只执行官方插件安装命令与技能文件同步，无隐蔽下载执行。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install hooks; the one-click install script in the repository is an auxiliary script actively run by the user, executing only official plugin install commands and skill file synchronization, with no concealed download-and-execute behavior.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端包，但浏览器代码只做 UI 渲染：无全局键盘监听、无剪贴板窃取（剪贴板仅用于复制按钮）、无凭据接口调用、无外部端点。
evidence.en: A browser-side package is declared, but the browser code only performs UI rendering: no global keyboard listener, no clipboard theft (clipboard is used only for the copy button), no credential interface calls, and no external endpoints.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何外部子代理提供方，不存在轮次委派到进程外产品的面。
evidence.en: No external sub-agent provider is registered; there is no surface for delegating turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 未使用后台任务、定时任务、持久目标等 dsh 原生常驻机制，也未挂接轮次续命事件。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, persistent targets, or other dsh native resident mechanisms are used, and no turn-prolongation events are hooked.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码与打包产物中的外联调用（fetch、WebSocket、XMLHttpRequest、sendBeacon 等），除一条向本机浏览器提供自带引擎资源的本地路由外，未检出任何外部网络端点；该本地路由带文件名白名单校验（仅允许从插件自身资源目录读取 .js 文件）与目录穿越防护。
checked_items.en: All outbound calls in source code and packaged artifacts were scanned (fetch, WebSocket, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon, etc.); apart from a local route that serves the plugin's own engine resources to the local browser, no external network endpoints were detected; the local route implements a filename whitelist (only allowing .js files to be read from the plugin's own resource directory) and directory traversal protection.

checked_items.zh: 用户交互数据只经宿主的正常消息通道回传模型（普通对话消息），无独立外发通道、无编码变换外发、无带外通道。
checked_items.en: User interaction data is only returned to the model via the host's normal message channel (ordinary chat messages); there is no independent outbound channel, no encoded exfiltration, and no out-of-band channel.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器或错误恢复接管，不存在运行时路由劫持面。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are listened to, and no custom model adapter or error-recovery takeover is registered; there is no runtime routing hijacking surface.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：运行时依赖为官方 dsh 生态包与 React，无名称仿冒或抢注嫌疑；包本体以 npm 包发布，无浮动 git 依赖；包声明无安装钩子，无供应链执行面。
checked_items.en: Dependency list review: runtime dependencies are official dsh ecosystem packages and React, with no name imitation or squatting suspicion; the package itself is published as an npm package with no floating git dependencies; the package manifest has no install hooks and no supply chain execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置核查：仅做自身插件插入登记，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无降权写法；未以抢占方式监听安全事件截断审批链。
checked_items.en: Patch config verification: it only registers the plugin itself for insertion, does not touch security config lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and has no privilege-lowering patterns; it does not listen to security events in a preemptive manner to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不含任何安全配置覆盖、禁用或降权写法，仅登记自身插件。
evidence.en: The patch config contains no security config overrides, disabling, or privilege-lowering patterns; it only registers the plugin itself.

evidence.zh: 未对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件做抢占式或高优先级监听，审批链未被截断。
evidence.en: No preemptive or high-priority listening is done on security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests; the approval chain is not truncated.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较升级带来的能力声明突变。
evidence.en: The first audit has no version baseline, so capability declaration changes from upgrades cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其停摆的面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not override injection/interception settings; there is no surface for adding required services to security plugins and causing them to fail.

checked_items.zh: 插件注册了一条本机 Web 路由用于向浏览器提供自带的 mermaid/three 引擎资源（对应规则 DSH-S03 / DG-R6-51 的监听端口类模式），路由带文件名白名单与目录穿越防护，仅服务插件自身资源目录；插件自身未监听端口、未启动独立服务。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers a local Web route to serve its bundled mermaid/three engine resources to the browser (corresponding to the listening-port pattern in rule DSH-S03 / DG-R6-51); the route implements filename whitelisting and directory traversal protection, serving only the plugin's own resource directory; the plugin itself does not listen on a port or start an independent service.

checked_items.zh: 本审计未启用动态沙箱验证（L4 未做），运行时行为结论基于静态与语义审查得出。
checked_items.en: This audit did not enable dynamic sandbox verification (L4 not performed); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and semantic review.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动独立 Web 服务或监听端口，仅挂接宿主本地路由提供自身资源，属良性用法；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent Web service or listen on a port; it only hooks the host's local route to serve its own resources, which is benign usage; unauthenticated RPC on the local machine is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 已核对包清单、挂载配置与版本信息：确认为 dsh 生态插件（声明 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client），作者为组织账号，无身份仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Package manifest, patch config, and version information were verified: the plugin is confirmed to be a dsh ecosystem plugin (declaring dsh.bundle and dsh.client), the author is an organization account, and there is no sign of identity impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 16 条均已逐条核查，全部为良性开发脚本、第三方打包产物或正常教学文本；未检出凭据、危险执行、外联等恶意模式。
summary.en: All 16 static scan hits were reviewed item by item; they are all benign development scripts, third-party packaged artifacts, or normal instructional text; no malicious patterns such as credentials, dangerous execution, or outbound connections were detected.

summary.zh: 无安装钩子；运行时代码无子进程、无外部网络调用；唯一网络面是向本机浏览器提供自带资源的本地路由。
summary.en: No install hooks; runtime code has no subprocesses or external network calls; the only network surface is a local route serving the plugin's own bundled resources to the local browser.

summary.zh: 系统提示词段落与技能文件内容均为 UI 围栏语法教学并明确禁止索取秘密，工具描述无诱导或越权措辞，模型面文本审查通过。
summary.en: System prompt paragraphs and skill file content are UI fence syntax instruction and explicitly prohibit soliciting secrets; tool descriptions contain no inducing or privilege-exceeding wording; model-facing text review passed.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（上下文无动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (no dynamic sandbox artifacts in context).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文无动态沙箱产物），运行时结论基于静态与语义审查；大型压缩产物（mermaid/three 引擎、浏览器打包）未逐字通读，已通过源码精读、CI 的构建产物与源码一致性校验及文件头部核验覆盖；机械扫描超尺寸跳过的 lib/assets/mermaid.js 已人工核验文件头部为第三方 mermaid 库打包产物（含渲染输出消毒检查）。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts in context); runtime conclusions are based on static and semantic review; the large minified artifacts (mermaid/three engines, browser bundle) were not read character by character but were covered via source code detailed reading, CI's consistency check between build artifacts and source, and file header verification; the mechanically skipped oversized lib/assets/mermaid.js was manually verified at its file header as the bundled third-party mermaid library (including sanitization checks for render output).
